tool_input.command:
cat >> db/schema.ts <<'EOF'

export const postRevisions = sqliteTable("post_revisions", {
  id: integer("id").primaryKey({ autoIncrement: true }),
  postId: integer("post_id").notNull(),
  title: text("title").notNull(),
  excerpt: text("excerpt").notNull(),
  body: text("body").notNull(),
  createdAt: text("created_at").notNull().default(sql`(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))`),
});
EOF
pnpm exec void db generate 2>&1 | tail -15; git status --short

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='lib/posts.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('import { posts } from "@schema";\nimport { db, eq } from "void/db";','import { postRevisions, posts } from "@schema";\nimport { db, eq } from "void/db";')
s+='''
/** Overwrites a post's title, excerpt and body, keeping the version it had before as a revision. */
export async function updatePostKeepingRevision(
  post: { id: number; title: string; excerpt: string; body: string },
  values: { title: string; excerpt: string; body: string },
): Promise<void> {
  await db
    .insert(postRevisions)
    .values({ postId: post.id, title: post.title, excerpt: post.excerpt, body: post.body });
  await db
    .update(posts)
    .set({ title: values.title, excerpt: values.excerpt, body: values.body })
    .where(eq(posts.id, post.id));
}
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='pages/posts/[id].server.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('import { posts } from "@schema";','import { postRevisions, posts } from "@schema";')
s=s.replace('parsePostId } from','parsePostId, updatePostKeepingRevision } from')
s=s.replace('await db.update(posts).set(body).where(eq(posts.id, post.id));','await updatePostKeepingRevision(post, body);')
s=s.replace('    await db.delete(posts)','    await db.delete(postRevisions).where(eq(postRevisions.postId, post.id));\n    await db.delete(posts)')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='pages/posts/[id].tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''Edit</Link>{" "}''','''Edit</Link>{" "}
          <Link href={`/posts/${post.id}/revisions`}>History</Link>{" "}''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
mkdir -p "pages/posts/[id]/revisions"

result:
Post revisions are in and `pnpm typecheck` passes. I didn't run the app or the hidden tests, so none of the new routes has been exercised.

- **Storage:** `db/schema.ts` has a new `postRevisions` table (`post_revisions`). I generated the migration with `void db generate`; it's `db/migrations/20261018122241_talented_warpath.sql` plus its snapshot and journal entry.
- **Keeping versions:** a new `updatePostKeepingRevision` helper in `lib/posts.ts` saves the post's current title, excerpt and body as a revision, then applies the new values. The `update` action in `pages/posts/[id].server.ts` uses it.
  - Creating a post, or an edit that is refused, keeps nothing.
  - The two writes are not in a transaction. I skipped `db.batch()` because the docs say it needs an updated platform. If the update failed after the insert, you'd get a stray revision.
- **History page:** `/posts/:id/revisions` is `pages/posts/[id]/revisions.server.ts` and `revisions.tsx`. It returns `revisions: [{ id, title, createdAt }]`, newest first, and each entry has a Restore button. The post page now shows a "History" link for the author.
- **Restore:** `POST /posts/:id/revisions/:revisionId/restore` is `routes/posts/[id]/revisions/[revisionId]/restore.ts`. It restores through the same helper, so the version just before the restore is also kept, then redirects to `/posts/:id`.
  - A revision that belongs to another post, or has an invalid id, gives 404.
  - The Restore button calls this route with a plain `fetch`, because Void's typed `action()` only accepts page actions. It then navigates to the post.
- **Authorization:** both routes redirect guests to `/login` and return 403 for a signed-in user who isn't the author.
- **Delete:** the `delete` action now removes the post's revision rows before deleting the post.
